title: Employ staff under the Nursery Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Nursery Award 2020.

sources.title: Nursery Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the nursery industry and their employees in the classifications listed in Schedule A —Classification Definitions to the exclusion of any other award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Nursery Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 Nursery industry means: (a) the propagation, planting, growing, cultivation, maintenance, sale, distribution or treating of plant material and associated nursery products in plant nurseries, flower, turf and tree farms or other similar enterprises; (b) the production and modification of growing media and clearing, treating or preparing of land for the propagation, planting, growing, cultivation, maintenance, sales and distribution or treating of plant material and associated products; (c) the processing, grading, packing or storing of plant material and associated products as part of a nursery; and (d) the despatching and distribution of plant material and associated products in connection with work under clauses 4.2(a) to (c) .

assessment.summary: The Nursery Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
